description: writes an HTML report of every Gifts & Love Offerings expense in one year of the live non-profit books, with source details per row and duplicate gifts flagged, read-only against the database
notes: Drives adws/adw_gifts_love_offerings_report.py, which reuses adw_interface_category_spreadsheet.py's category resolver and duplicate-detection rule, and that file's own reuse of adw_interface_live_finance.py's ReadOnlyBooks Decorator and READ ONLY session -- so this agent cannot change a record even if its prompt were ignored. No Write or Edit tool: the ADW writes the HTML file itself, and output_path is where it puts it, so this agent needs no way to write a file of its own.
